critical_claims.value: 4 March 1681 royal charter is proprietary and English Crown claim, not Lenape or Haudenosaunee transfer or actual settled footprint
15 July 1682 deed Delaware to Neshaminy on preserved document reference; transaction parties and conditions may differ from modern land title assumptions
tradition claims 1682 peace meeting; no surviving documentary treaty text; no claim of signed instrument
Thomas Holme map of improved parts only and copy may be later edition of 1687 content; not entire colony ownership polygon
1629 Kirke English occupation followed by treaty 1632 restitution France; distinguish royal diplomatic cession from same-year local handover and Champlain 1633 return
Government states one Black and one Indian worker from West Indies came 1616 indentured for pearl diving; no support for hereditary lifetime chattel from this pair
1647 Bahamas government constitutional commission Eleutheran settlement; tourism body says 1649. Keep window 1647-1649 and do not force exact 1648 year as certainty.
Bahamas Government says six Carolina Lords Proprietors received 1670 grant; not proof they occupied every inhabited island
May 1686 Dudley provisional, December Andros, CT Rhode Island integration over time, New York New Jersey added 1688; royal commission boundaries not effective onsite control map
Boston rebellion April 18 1689 overthrew Andros, government restored over several steps until 1692, contested land title status not instant reset
